rules.win: The game ends at the end of the round in which the detent screw reaches its bottom stop and the setter calls 'Bottom' (the bar starts 31 clicks above the stop and every mandatory Set drops it 2, 4 or 6 clicks, so this is forced within 15 rounds). Each round, the tallest committed block that passes under the bar without moving it wins, and its owner adds it plus the tallest block scrapped that round to their score line; blocks that touch the bar are scrapped permanently, and tied tallest blocks are all scrapped with no winner. The winner of the game is the player whose score line - their won blocks laid end to end - is longest, i.e. the greatest sum of won block heights. Ties break by: fewer blocks in the line, then more blocks left in the rail, then fewer times as setter, then clockwise from the last setter.
